Market read this week
Rate trigger hit, start preparing
Act now signal: rate below 7.3%
Prices▼ easier

Tracy values are near $690k, down about 5.5% year over year (Zillow). Redfin shows the August median sale price near $675k, up about 2.8%, with homes selling in about 28 days, so the picture is mixed. Not a clear turn up yet; watch it.

Rates▼ easier

30yr fixed fell again to 7.24% (Freddie Mac, Oct 29), down from 7.32% and the lowest level this month. That is now under the roughly 7.3% trigger, so the rate signal is firing. Fannie Mae's 2027 outlook is still near 7.5%, so one soft week is not a trend; be ready to move sooner if it holds.

Rate watch: today about 7.24% (Freddie Mac 30yr fixed average, Oct 29 2026, down from 7.32%); Zillow quotes about 7.13% note rate and 7.30% APR with points today.  2027 forecast about 7.5% average (Fannie Mae, Oct 12 2026).  Triggers to move early: a 30yr rate dropping below roughly 7.3% (now 7.24%, so this one is firing), or Tracy prices turning back up (not firing; Zillow still shows values down about 5.5% year over year, Redfin shows August median $675k, up 2.8%). Next step: confirm the rate holds for another week or two.

What was screened. The search covers all of Tracy up to $570k (no neighborhood exclusions), and every home here is a single family residence on its own parcel (you own the home and the land), with no HOA, no 55+ restriction, and no pool or spa, each checked against its listing. Dropped for a pool or spa: 3351 Cabrillo Dr, 111 E 21st St, 1881 Thomas Dehaven Ln, 1250 Coolidge Ave, and 1631 Bondy Ln. 1840 Village Dr no longer appears in active listings. Two story is preferred and badged when found; single story is fine. Homes that only your agent can see through the MLS may not appear here; send the address and it can be added.
How the money is figured. Down payment and loan from the price and your selected down percent. Closing costs estimated at 2.5% of price (CA buyer side usually runs 2% to 3%). Cash to close is down plus closing. Monthly payment is principal and interest at the chosen rate, plus property tax at about 1.2% per year and insurance about $190 per month. Newer south and west tracts can carry Mello-Roos, which would add roughly $100 to $300 per month; verify per home. These are estimates, not a lending quote, and are not financial advice.
